content.short: OMNIA Protocol is a decentralized and privacy-preserving RPC infrastructure layer offering censorship-resistant blockchain access on Mantle.
content.description: OMNIA Protocol is a decentralized RPC infrastructure that prioritizes user privacy and censorship resistance in blockchain access. Unlike traditional RPC providers that log transaction requests and can theoretically censor transactions, OMNIA routes requests through a decentralized network of node operators with privacy-preserving technology. The protocol also offers MEV protection by shielding transactions from front-running bots. OMNIA supports Mantle Network, providing developers and users with a more private and secure method of interacting with the blockchain.
